'''Oslom''' was a male [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed at the [[Leth Outpost]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he asked an Imperial to rid the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] of the military-grade adrenals.
